q1_issues.issue: The clause's verb "runs" is not represented at all — no event is reified and no status/role atom stands in for it; the instruction set licenses dropping a stative verb only for the stative-locative list routed onto LocatedIn ("is located in / lies in / sits in / is situated in"), which "runs parallel to" is not.

q2_gaps: a predicative spatial-configuration adjective with a "to"-complement carried by a stative motion verb ("runs parallel to the shore", "runs alongside", "faces onto") — neither the LocatedIn routing nor the preposition-named oblique nor the copular Member form fits, and the Symmetric open-class license is worded for relations "the copula itself asserts" (its examples are copular plus the single stative verb "resembles")
notes: Parallel is left off the unlicensed list because it is a stative mutual predicate and the parse does emit the required (Symmetric Parallel) tag, which is the open-class license — but the license's wording (copula-asserted) does not clearly reach "runs parallel to", so this head sits on the boundary. The compound kind lakeside_road with genus (Inheritance lakeside_road road) and no modifier genus, and the fresh definite witness sk_shore_1, are both correct.
